shortDescription: Information module for Backup Restore Executions

options.name: backupId
options.description: BackupId query parameter. The `backupId` of the backup execution to be retrieved.Obtain the `backupId` from the id attribute in the response of the `/dna/system/api/v1/backups` API.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The `id` of the backup execution to be retrieved.

options.name: jobType
options.description: JobType query parameter. Execution type of the backup workflow. If the workflow is `Create Backup` The jobType is `CREATE_BACKUP`. If the workflow is `Delete Backup` The jobType is `DELETE_BACKUP`. If the workflow is `Restore Backup` The jobType is `RESTORE_BACKUP`.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.Use `asc` for ascending and `desc` for descending order .

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: status
options.description: Status query parameter. Execution status of the workflow.If the workflow execution has started, the status is `IN_PROGRESS`.If the workflow execution has completed, the status is `SUCCESS`.If the workflow execution has failed, the status is `FAILED`.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
